items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: I also knew Furry Lewis, uh, quite well, uh, when I was a kid, since he, too, traveled with and performed with the show.

ctx.x: What, uh, was the name of the carnival?

The carnival was called the... there were two units of what was called the Greater Holkamp show. Mm-hmm. And, uh, these toured through the South and Southwest. Um, and we're now talking about, uh, the period from 1920 to 23, roughly. And, uh, of course, I also knew Furry Lewis, uh, quite well, uh, when I was a kid, since he, too, traveled with and performed with the show.
Uh, it didn't... the carnival didn't take the name of your father or family or anything?
